snippet.title: Super Box Box Demo Trailer
snippet.description: Super Box Box is a gimmick-based, old-school, 2d platformer. Make your way throughout the plenty of levels using your core mechanic: a carryable box. Interact with the gimmicks as you visit different biomes. Demo release on 8th of March 2023: https://twitter.com/Kepsert
